Provided, however, that all aliens admitted as religious missionaries under this Decree shall be exempted from
the payment of monthly extension fees that are due from temporary visitors.
(b) No fee shall be charged for a passport visa granted to a foreign government officials or his family,
attendants, and household helpers, and employees, nor shall be a fee charged for a passport visa for a non-
immigrant in transit to a destination outside the Philippines.
Any provisions of laws, orders, rules and regulations, or parts thereof, in conflict or inconsistent herewith are
hereby repealed or modified accordingly.
This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 31st day of July, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-four.
